description: blueteam.brand's GZCoord integration: the brand's one role, brand-comms, is on the fleet's coordination channel with the consumers it announces copies to (blueteam.ee first) — the same relay and channel as every other project of the fleet, hosted on the coordinator's workspace. Read by gzcoord-inbox when the working copy resolves to project blueteam.brand; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment override it. No token_env_file: the account's token arrives with fabric-secrets sync. relay_runtime_dir is relative to the workspace, never inside a repository. Written 2026-10-19, at registration.
